'''Chief Magistrate''' was a title in the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. [[Ozzik Sturn]] was, at one point in his career, a Chief [[Magistrate/Legends|Magistrate]] on [[Malastare/Legends|Malastare]].
